$comment: GLOBAL EMAIL CONFIGURATION. Committed, so it must never contain a secret.
Credentials come from the environment only: VAHINI_SMTP_USER / VAHINI_SMTP_PASS.
For Gmail, VAHINI_SMTP_PASS is a 16-character App Password, NOT the account
password -- Gmail rejects the account password for SMTP. See README.md.
Per-host overrides go in email.config.local.json (gitignored, see the example
file next to this one). Every value here can also be overridden by an env var;
the precedence and the full var list are in README.md.

smtp.$comment: Standard Gmail submission. 587 + STARTTLS; use 465 with secure:true for implicit TLS.

$comment: Reference only -- the persist API sends mail and never reads it, so nothing
in the codebase consumes this block. It lives here so the mailbox's settings
are in one place for whoever configures a desktop or phone client.
Requires POP to be switched on in Gmail: Settings -> Forwarding and POP/IMAP.
From must be the authenticated Gmail account (or an alias verified under
Gmail's 'Send mail as'). Gmail rewrites or refuses anything else, so setting
this to noreply@vahinitech.com without verifying that alias first would
either silently change the visible sender or fail the send.
